mapper.select: select a.id, b.name, b.phone, (select label from base_dict_data where type = 'GRAIN_VARIETY' and description = a.grain_variety) as grainVariety, (select label from base_dict_data where type = 'GRAIN_SOURCE_TYPE' and description = CAST(a.grain_source_type AS VARCHAR)) as grainSourceType, a.plan_weight as planWeight, a.completed_weight as completedWeight, a.state, a.start_time as startTime, a.end_time as endTime, a.remarks, c.name as addUser, a.add_time as addTime from warehouse_in_order a left join sts_customer b on b.id = a.customer_id left join base_user_info c on c.id = a.add_user where a.id = #{id}

select a.id, b.name, (select label from base_dict_data where type = 'GRAIN_VARIETY' and description = a.grain_variety) as grainVariety, (select label from base_dict_data where type = 'GRAIN_SOURCE_TYPE' and description = CAST(a.grain_source_type AS VARCHAR)) as grainSourceType, a.plan_weight as planWeight, a.completed_weight as completedWeight, a.state, a.start_time as startTime, a.end_time as endTime, c.name as addUser, a.add_time as addTime from warehouse_in_order a left join sts_customer b on a.customer_id =b.id left join base_user_info c on c.id = a.add_user
and b.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and a.grain_variety = #{grainVariety}
order by a.add_time desc
select grain_variety as grainVariety from warehouse_in_order where id in (select order_id from task_flow where id = #{taskId})
